name: Pixie
source: A young Pixie, she was created by [url=/c102976]Morgana[/url] from the Artifact, though the process was flawed, leading Morgana to dub her 'a mistake'. For a long time she believed it… but since meeting the MC, she has begun to think that maybe she's worth something after all…
